Create a temporary email inbox in one tap and keep spam out of your real inbox.

Temp Mail lets you instantly generate a disposable email address and receive emails right away, including photos and other attachments. No sign-up required. Your personal email stays private.

Stop sharing your real email address everywhere. Doing so often leads to spam, advertising emails, phishing attempts, and security risks. With Temp Mail, your primary inbox stays clean, private, and secure.

Temp Mail provides free, disposable email addresses inspired by popular 10-minute mail services, but with a more reliable experience, modern user interface and powerful premium features.

Why use Temp Mail?

• Keep your real email address out of spam and phishing
• No registration required
• Privacy-focused by design
• Emails stored only while your address is active
• Automatic email expiration and deletion
• Instantly receive emails and attachments
• Push notifications for new messages
• Copy email address to clipboard in one tap


What you can do with Temp Mail

• Generate a new temporary email address instantly
• Copy your email address to use on websites and apps
• Receive emails and attachments automatically
• Get push notifications for incoming messages
• Read emails and download attachments to your device
• View email source files
• Delete old inboxes and create new ones anytime


Unlock more with Temp Mail Pro

• Multiple active mailboxes
• Premium email domains
• Extended email storage
• Priority customer support
• Completely ad-free experience


FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions about Temp Mail)

- How long do temporary email addresses last?
Each inbox remains active for 3 hours by default. With a PRO membership, you can extend this period up to 24 hours. Once expired, all messages are automatically deleted.

- Can I send emails from my temporary address?
Temporary email addresses are designed for receiving emails only. Sending outgoing emails is not supported to help prevent misuse and maintain service reliability.

- Can I recover a deleted or expired email address?
Unfortunately, once an email address expires, it cannot be recovered. However, with PRO membership you get extended inbox lifetimes and can keep your addresses active much longer.

- Can I create multiple email addresses?
Yes! Free users can have up to 1 active mailbox, while PRO users have access to up to 10 mailboxes.

Frequently Asked Questions

- How long do temp email addresses last?
Temporary email addresses expire after a set period of time (typically a few hours to a few days). This helps keep your inbox clean and reduces long-term spam. Once expired, the address can no longer receive emails.

- Do I need to sign up or create an account?
No sign-up required. Open the temp mail app, tap to generate an address, and start using it immediately. No registration, no passwords, no hassle.

- Can I use these addresses for important accounts?
We recommend using disposable emails for one-time verifications, free trials, newsletters, and untrusted signups. For important accounts like banking or healthcare, use your real email address.
